cover_letter:
Dear eCarsTrade team,

I'm applying for the CRM Manager position. Your description of boosting dealer retention and activation through experiments and automation is exactly the kind of work I enjoy: technical enough to build things, commercial enough to know why they matter.

My background is in digital marketing with a technical foundation. I work daily with HTML, CSS and JavaScript, and I use Python and LLM-based tools to automate repetitive tasks. At Episto I handle on-page SEO and content for client websites, manage WordPress and Shopify stores, and track performance in Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs. On my own projects I've built sites from scratch, implemented structured data, and run iterative audits that measurably improved search health. I also hold HubSpot Content Marketing certification, which gave me a solid grounding in lifecycle communication and campaign structure.

For this role, the parts that fit best are A/B testing and funnel analysis, QA of my own work, and translating business needs into technical solutions. I haven't managed HubSpot workflows at scale, but I've built and maintained CMS workflows, set up tracking, and automated processes with no-code and code-based tools. I learn systems quickly and I'm comfortable prioritizing incoming requests in a fast-moving environment.

I'd like to bring that mix to eCarsTrade and help improve dealer retention, activation and vehicle purchases through better direct communication and sales automation. I'm based in Belgium and available fully remote.

Thank you for considering my application. I'd be glad to discuss how I can contribute.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com

• Automation with LLMs, MCP integrations, Python and no-code/low-code tools to execute complex tasks efficiently
